home.currentWork: I'm the founder of {mediacreators}, The Creator Business OS, based in Santiago, Chile. With over 20 years of experience building digital products, I enjoy sharing my knowledge and insights with the community {thoughts} and {talks}.
home.background: I started in the development world in 2004, experimenting with computers (often breaking things) and learning to program by researching online. At just 15, I built my first website — and never stopped. In 2010, I launched my first entrepreneurial venture with my first clients, and fell even more in love with technology.
home.mission: My personal mission is to build the digital infrastructure of the future for creators, giving them the tools to control their own business.

services.logosBody: The ones on my public LinkedIn.

diego.quote: Working with Ivan on my teams was a genuine pleasure. He brings deep expertise across multiple disciplines, with particular strength in frontend engineering — and, rarely, the ability to connect technical decisions directly to business outcomes. When someone can articulate why a frontend library should be implemented or upgraded in terms of what it unlocks for the business, you have a team that can demonstrate real ROI rather than just ship code. Ivan is also an exceptional mentor, investing in the people around him and consistently raising the bar for the professionals on his team. Any organization would benefit from having him.
diego.name: Diego H. Mazzitelli

alex.quote: It was a pleasure working with Iván. As Tech Director, he consistently planned ahead, anticipating risks and dependencies before they became problems while still moving fast and keeping an eye for detail. Great leader, always pushing people forward.
alex.name: Alex Otero

payment.question: How do payments work?
payment.answer: Milestone-based payments: the first one at kickoff, the rest against deliverables. Advisory is billed monthly. I send an invoice, we put a short agreement in writing before starting, and you can pay by bank transfer or card.

remote.question: Do you work with companies outside Chile?
remote.answer: Yes. Remote, in English and Spanish, with U.S. time-zone overlap.

stack.question: What stack do you use?
stack.answer: TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, GCP and Cloudflare. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and AWS Bedrock.
